# RevolveLED

> > Commercial and outdoor LED lighting solutions featuring Konlite, Howard Lighting, and energy-efficient fixtures with DLC Premium and Energy Star certifications.

RevolveLED specializes in commercial-grade LED lighting products including parking lot lights, high bay fixtures, wall packs, flood lights, and accessories. The site offers energy-efficient replacements for traditional HID and MH fixtures with products certified by Design Lights Consortium (DLC) and UL.

## Key Topics

- Konlite LED fixtures
- DLC Premium certification
- Parking lot lighting
- LED high bay lights
- Wall pack lights
- Outdoor flood lights
- HID/MH replacements
- Wattage selectable fixtures
- Dusk-to-dawn sensors
- Howard Lighting products
- Energy Star certified
- Commercial lighting solutions
- Emergency backup systems
- NEMA enclosures
- UL listed products
